subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 5: Vocabulary and Grammar – Places of entertainment; Present continuous for future arrangements
outcomes: Use the Present continuous for future arrangements.
Talk and write about your own plans.

tf.s: You skate at an ice rink.
tf.why: Yes, an ice rink has ice for skating.

tf.s: You can see fish, sharks and turtles at an aquarium.
tf.why: Yes, an aquarium has sea animals.

tf.s: A planetarium has stars and planets on the ceiling.
tf.why: Yes, it shows the night sky.

tf.s: You watch films with special glasses at a bowling alley.
tf.why: That is a 3D cinema; at a bowling alley you play bowling.

tf.s: We can use the Present continuous for fixed future plans.
tf.why: Yes: We're watching a show on Tuesday.

tf.s: The Present continuous is am/is/are + verb-ing.
tf.why: For example: is taking, are visiting.

tf.s: “I'm flying to Cairo on Monday” is about now.
tf.why: On Monday shows it is a future arrangement.

tf.s: “She isn't coming to the circus tonight” is a correct negative.
A safari park is a place to see paintings.
tf.why: You see paintings at an art gallery; a safari park has wild animals.

tf.s: “Tomorrow we visiting the park” is correct.
tf.why: We need are: Tomorrow we are visiting the park.

boxes.q: Where do you watch films with glasses?
She ___ (not / come) to the circus tonight.
My dad ___ (take) us to the theme park this evening.
Which is a time expression for the future?
boxes.why: Next week is in the future.

boxes.q: Make negative: We are going out tonight.
Which place has rides like a roller coaster?
Where do clowns and acrobats perform?
boxes.why: A circus has clowns and acrobats.

hunt.q: Place with stars on the ceiling

mcq.q: Which place has stars and planets on the ceiling?
Where can you see fish, sharks and turtles?
How do we make the Present continuous?
Which word is a place of entertainment?
mcq.why: People go to a bowling alley for fun.

mcq.q: Ask a question: you / visit / the safari park / next week?
o: Are you visiting the safari park next week?
Do you visiting the safari park next week?
You are visit the safari park next week?
Is you visiting the safari park next week?

mcq.q: Complete: My cousins ___ us at the theme park on Friday.
Which sentence is about a future arrangement?
o: I'm visiting my grandma on Thursday.
I visited my grandma last week.
I visit my grandma every day.
mcq.why: On Thursday shows a fixed future plan.

o: I'm flying to Cairo on Monday.
mcq.why: It has a future time and a fixed plan.

mcq.q: Why is the Present continuous used in: We're watching a show on Tuesday?
o: It is a future arrangement; they have decided and have tickets.
mcq.why: Fixed plans with a time use the Present continuous.

mcq.q: Which time expression does NOT go with a future arrangement?
mcq.why: Last night is in the past.
